items.title: Flatness after a base change makes the natural map on Tor one surjective
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For ring maps R to R' to R'' and an R-module M whose first base change is flat over R', the lemma states that the natural map from Tor_1(M, R') tensor R'' to Tor_1(M, R'') is surjective (statement lines 24062-24069). The proof does not compute Tor with a resolution over R'': it takes one free resolution over R, identifies both Tor groups as quotients of the kernels after the two base changes, tensors the exact sequence for the first base change with R'', and uses flatness to keep it exact, which makes the map on kernels surjective (proof lines 24071-24095). Using a single resolution for both computations, so that the comparison becomes a map of kernels, is the content of the argument. H2.
